known_limits: the vertex colour caps every texel at ~124/255 on screen; v4 gains about +8-10% luminance on the panes (whitened R/B) plus the spill halo, so windows read brighter and glow softly but cannot glow like H24 (whose quads are not darkened this much)
the white core is near-neutral after modulation; the cyan identity is kept at pane edges and in the spill
calibration from one live frame (robin-0030); quad-to-quad gouraud varies k by about +-5%

v3 forced texel-centre cores: class boundaries now move only between centres; at straightened island outlines that border another class, a forced centre can leave a 1-pixel (1024) / 2x2 (2048) native notch. Review sheets in review/v2-review-copied were rendered from v2 (identical except at forced cores); the v3 robin-0120 recomposition is in review/.

Material is procedural-from-polygons + one generated swatch; no per-island AI repaint. Plates read as painted armour with seams, bolts and edge wear at medium scale, but surfaces are cleaner/more uniform than a hand-painted asset.

Seams/bolts exist only where GP0 snapshots (3 frames) showed polygons; islands seen only in rate-sampled capture triangles get paint wear and plate tone but no fold seams. Texels outside all real polygons keep v1 bbox ownership.
Swatch is mirror-tiled: a faint mirror axis can be found in big flat panels on close inspection.

Coarse native staircases are straightened by group-size tolerance (up to 2.6 texels): a few genuine small notches on big plates are smoothed away; one larger step on the 38DC02FE shoulder housing remains.
Bolt heads are bare-metal grey (not emissive); at 1024-calm they soften to dots.
Recomposition review uses GP0 frame 8717 while robin-0120 was taken at 8721-8724 (pose may differ by a few frames); it is a SIMULATION, not a game capture.

Strip keys are cut from the same page renders (2048x64 / 1024x32). In robin-0120 the housing slashes still looked stepped although the page key was submitted: please confirm which of page key / strip key wins for rows 0-7 (strip 3B9C8491-6E78D825) and install page + strips of this candidate together.

Seam classes (visible dark lines) come from sampled triangles + same-line extension + walled/same-island slots: a dark gap that is really visible but never sampled and not walled is padded shut

Real composite (frame 3995) covers only the five sampled triangle slivers plus their island extension (~60 native px): the hull cannot be re-rendered whole from a sampled capture

v3 forced texel-centre cores: class boundaries now move only between centres; at straightened island outlines that border another class, a forced centre can leave a 1-pixel (1024) / 2x2 (2048) native notch. Review sheets in review/v2-review-copied were rendered from v2 (identical except at forced cores); the v3 robin-0120 recomposition is in review/.

Material is procedural-from-polygons + one generated swatch; no per-island AI repaint. Plates read as painted armour with seams, bolts and edge wear at medium scale, but surfaces are cleaner/more uniform than a hand-painted asset.

Seams/bolts exist only where GP0 snapshots (3 frames) showed polygons; islands seen only in rate-sampled capture triangles get paint wear and plate tone but no fold seams. Texels outside all real polygons keep v1 bbox ownership.
Swatch is mirror-tiled: a faint mirror axis can be found in big flat panels on close inspection.

Coarse native staircases are straightened by group-size tolerance (up to 2.6 texels): a few genuine small notches on big plates are smoothed away; one larger step on the 38DC02FE shoulder housing remains.
Bolt heads are bare-metal grey (not emissive); at 1024-calm they soften to dots.
Recomposition review uses GP0 frame 8717 while robin-0120 was taken at 8721-8724 (pose may differ by a few frames); it is a SIMULATION, not a game capture.

Strip keys are cut from the same page renders (2048x64 / 1024x32). In robin-0120 the housing slashes still looked stepped although the page key was submitted: please confirm which of page key / strip key wins for rows 0-7 (strip 3B9C8491-6E78D825) and install page + strips of this candidate together.

Seams/bolts exist only where GP0 snapshots (3 frames) showed polygons; islands seen only in rate-sampled capture triangles get paint wear and plate tone but no fold seams. Texels outside all real polygons keep v1 bbox ownership.
Swatch is mirror-tiled: a faint mirror axis can be found in big flat panels on close inspection.

Coarse native staircases are straightened by group-size tolerance (up to 2.6 texels): a few genuine small notches on big plates are smoothed away; one larger step on the 38DC02FE shoulder housing remains.
Bolt heads are bare-metal grey (not emissive); at 1024-calm they soften to dots.
Recomposition review uses GP0 frame 8717 while robin-0120 was taken at 8721-8724 (pose may differ by a few frames); it is a SIMULATION, not a game capture.

Strip keys are cut from the same page renders (2048x64 / 1024x32). In robin-0120 the housing slashes still looked stepped although the page key was submitted: please confirm which of page key / strip key wins for rows 0-7 (strip 3B9C8491-6E78D825) and install page + strips of this candidate together.
